character: 310 km domain in the Maurienne valley. 6 villages, family-friendly, budget-conscious. Quieter alternative to the Tarentaise.
name: Les Sybelles
description: 310km of linked pistes across 6 Maurienne valley resorts: Le Corbier, La Toussuire, St-Jean-d'Arves, St-Sorlin-d'Arves, Les Karellis, and Le Bottières. 62 lifts. Known as 'La Sybelle' — a quiet, uncrowded alternative to the big Tarentaise domains. Family-friendly, excellent value, significantly cheaper than neighbouring Les 3 Vallées. Good intermediate terrain with a reputation for quiet slopes even in French school holidays.

lift_pass_pricing.note: One of the cheapest large domain passes in France. Excellent value for 310km.

suitability.beginners: Good — each village has dedicated beginner zones. Le Corbier has a good nursery slope.
suitability.intermediates: Very good — the bulk of the terrain is blue/red mid-altitude cruising.
suitability.families: Excellent value — uncrowded, cheap passes, family run
